name: paged
description:
Cortex pages with a search_from/search_to window of a hundred, and the walk only stops on a short page, so page one has to be exactly a hundred endpoints long for the second call to happen at all. The assertion is that call two carries search_from=100/search_to=200 - the window advanced by the page size rather than being resent - and that the run stops after the short second page instead of looping.

namespaced_ids is skipped because this integration uses the bare Cortex agent_id as the foreign id with no tenant scope at all. That is reported as a defect rather than accepted - see the report.
